correctness.rationale: The finite open-neighborhood facets are exactly T_(r,c), four vertices each. All nonempty nonrow-zero fibers are simplices, so toggling a fixed row-zero vertex gives a fiberwise acyclic matching. Remaining nonrow-zero critical faces are exactly n opposite-row-two edges, 4n triangles and n tetrahedra, paired in two additional dimension-specific acyclic families, leaving two critical 0-cells, two critical 1-cells and 2n critical 2-cells split equally by parity. The explicit integral column-displacement cocycle is closed on all triangles, evaluates to n on each row-zero cycle, and therefore forces every remaining 2-cell attaching degree to vanish. The resulting integral homotopy type is two disjoint copies of S^1 wedged with n S^2. A standard-library checker independently validates finite matchings, acyclicity, winding and mod-two chains; no infinite inference is based solely on numerical checks.

originality.rationale: The full 2026 toroidal-grid theorem is restricted to period lattices with minimal Manhattan period at least 5, while C4 square Cn has the excluded period (4,0). The inspected 2019 full-text four-regular circulant theorem includes the odd-n cyclic products, excluded from the new theorem; even-n products are noncirculant. A contemporary 2026 classification of 2-linear neighborhood complexes applies to graphs with no induced cycle longer than a square, whereas these graphs contain even n-cycles. Semantic records searches under equivalent descriptions and exact small parameters did not reveal a stronger covering theorem. This supports originality with stated residual unindexed-priority risk.
